Consonantal i

Theme

Work & responsibility · Travel & transport

schedule noun

also timetable, bus timetable, train timetable, time table

modern

Traupman 218, 374

hōrārium, hōrāriī n.

noun, second declension

a timetable, a schedule

Traupman’s word for a timetable of trains, buses and flights (hōrārium autoraedārum longārum, the bus timetable). In Lewis & Short hōrārium is only a late word for a clock (Censorinus); the timetable is a modern sense.

Other words

  • hōrārum index — a list of the hours

    also used · modern · Levi–Bini p. 44: liber hōrārum index

Examples

  • Hōrārium īnspice: quotā hōrā venit autoraeda longa?

    Look at the timetable: what time does the bus come?composed

See also bus, bus stop, train station, deadline, schedule.

SourcesLewis & Short: horarium · Lewis & Short: index

John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, pp. 218, 374, checked against the searchable text of the book (11 November 2026).

Enrico Levi and Arturo Bini, Il latino come lingua viva (1937), p. 44 (orario).

The example sentence marked “composed” is ours.
